title: EventsReadResult
description: events.read-result@1: answers of the pull API on OpenVibe.Events. GET /api/v1/events → { events: [{ cursor, event }], next_cursor, latest_cursor, gap? } (keep next_cursor as the position and read on with after=: it moves past events that did not match; latest_cursor is the head, for a consumer that starts at now; without after= a page starts at the oldest retained event; gap { from_seq, to_seq } says events after the position were already pruned by retention); GET /api/v1/events/:event_id → { cursor, event }; GET|PUT /api/v1/checkpoints → { consumer, topic, cursor, carrier, updated_at } (cursor, carrier and updated_at null when none is stored). GET /realtime/stream?topics= (events.event.read) is a Server-Sent Events feed whose messages carry { event } with the cursor as the SSE id; it resumes from Last-Event-ID (or last_event_id=) when that is a cursor, and a gap message comes first when the cursor is older than retention. A position is only ever an opaque cursor (ADR-042 decision 7): there is no per-event sequence number and no global order; dedupe on event.event_id. An app sees only its project's events in its token's environment plus public first-party events.

cursor.description: Opaque position (ADR-042): hand it back as after= to read on from here, or as Last-Event-ID; never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Opaque position after this page (ADR-042): pass it back as after= for the next page.

latest_cursor.description: The head as an opaque cursor (ADR-042): a consumer that starts at now stores it and reads on with after=.

cursor.description: Opaque position (ADR-042): hand it back as after= to read on from here, or as Last-Event-ID; never parse it.
The stored opaque cursor, as it was stored; null when none is.

carrier.description: The carrier the stored position is on (ADR-042), or null.
